name: Brake and land precisely
description: Move to a nearby target, brake before it and return to a marked landing.

steps.text: Use Angle mode. To stop forward travel, briefly tilt back, then level out. Releasing pitch alone does not stop momentum.
steps.title: Understand momentum and braking

steps.text: Take off and settle inside the start marker.
steps.title: Settle at the start

steps.text: Move to the next marker and brake before reaching it. Hold below 0.8 m/s for three seconds.
steps.title: Move forward and brake

steps.text: Return to the start marker and stop before descending.
steps.title: Return and stop

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land on the marker
